recipe.visualDefinition: A male portrait centered within a textured L-shaped border. The subject is seated in a relaxed pose against an industrial, warm-toned background featuring diagonal structural lines. The layout uses a distinct header area for the primary name and a script-based subtitle overlapping the image area.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm industrial background vs. cool purple textured border
Structured geometric background lines vs. organic seated pose
Bold serif header vs. fluid script subtitle
High-contrast lighting on the subject vs. diffused background glow
coreInvariants: L-shaped textured border framing the top and left
Diagonal metallic or architectural grid in the background
Subject wearing a dark blazer over a light shirt
Grainy, film-like texture across the entire composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, mid-shot from waist up, occupying approximately 60% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright white shirt collar serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top header, move down to the subject's face, follow the diagonal background lines to the script text, and rest on the clasped hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the textured purple border on the top and left edges.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted lavender/purple with a heavy noise texture for the outer frame.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and golden tones in the background lighting.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for the script text and deep navy/black for the subject's jacket.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow text and purple border; mid-range values in the photographic portrait with deep shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of a heavy slab-serif for the name and a casual brush script for the title.
letterConstructionRules: Header letters are wide with thick slabs and high contrast.
Subtitle letters are slanted, connected, and mimic hand-painted brush strokes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Header characters feature a thin yellow outline and a deep purple drop shadow to create depth against the textured background.

composition.position: middle left, overlapping image and border
composition.relationshipToImage: floats over the subject's torso area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, formal slab-serif and a casual, energetic script.
graphicDevices: Heavy grain texture on the border

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif structure of the header.
Captures the casual, hand-drawn feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with 80s-style feathered hair, wearing a black blazer and white t-shirt, seated in front of a warm-lit industrial grid background. Add a thick L-shaped border on the top and left side with a heavy purple noise/grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a bold slab-serif name in the top border area with a purple fill and yellow outline. Place a yellow brush-script title horizontally across the middle-left, overlapping the border and the subject.

verificationChecks: Is the border texture visible and grainy?
Does the script text overlap both the border and the photo?
Is the header text centered in the top purple bar?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the slab-serif has a visible drop shadow
Verify the subject's pose feels relaxed and centered
Confirm the background lighting is warm amber
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured L-frame border with a dual-font typographic system (Slab + Script) over a warm-lit industrial portrait.
